lesson: Core competences and the VRIO framework
title: VRIO: four questions about a resource
caption: A resource must pass all four tests to give a sustained competitive advantage. Fail the first and it is a disadvantage; fail the second, only parity; fail the third, an advantage that does not last.
alt: Four boxes in order: valuable, rare, inimitable, organised, each with what failing it means, ending in sustained competitive advantage.
description: Organised to exploit it? If yes to all four: sustained competitive advantage.
end: Yes to all four: sustained competitive advantage
